responseMessageContents.text:
No type errors in the profile page — the project structure warning is pre-existing and unrelated.

I've added an **Export PDF** button (the download icon) next to the existing share button in the profile header. When tapped, it:

- Generates a nicely styled PDF with your stats summary, category progress bars, highest summit highlight, and a full table of all summited peaks with dates
- On **iOS/Android**: saves the PDF and opens the share sheet so you can save, AirDrop, email, etc.
- On **web**: opens the browser's print dialog (save as PDF from there)

The PDF has a polished look with a gradient header, stat cards, progress bars, and a clean table layout.
